description: This script processes clang-format error logs to generate a JUnit XML report, identifying formatting errors in source files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that checks the log file, creates an XML report of errors, and exits with a message if errors are found.

methods.name: createErrorList
methods.description: Parses the clang-format error log file and returns a list of error dictionaries with filename and error info.
